title: Instacart Order Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=instacart:order
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by store_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Instacart order data has stopped arriving for a given store.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per store and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your Instacart order feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
